name: Raa Bistro
blurb: A new cafe in Park Circus with a relaxed vibe, elegant interiors and a comforting menu of coffee and hearty bites.

tips.tip: Handy between the Central and South Kolkata circuits.

name: AMPM (Park Street)
blurb: A Park Street cafe by day that turns into a bar by night. Named Best Bar in Kolkata and ranked No. 12 on the 30 Best Bars India list.
dishes: Before PM Martini (Bengali chilli liqueur, tequila, espresso)
Park Street Negroni with coffee-infused whisky

tips.expect: A seamless day-to-night format with live energy after dark.
tips.tip: A good Park Street stop before or after the Central pandals.

name: The Bhawanipur House
blurb: An all-day cafe in Bhowanipore that won Best All Day Cafe at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.tip: Close to the Bhowanipore and Kalighat routes.

name: ICanFlyy Tea Kafi
blurb: A tea and coffee cafe run by staff with special needs, with exposed brick walls and motivational quotes.

tips.tip: Near Ballygunge, so easy to add to the Gariahat and Ballygunge pandals.

name: Travelistan Cafe
blurb: A travel-themed cafe at Golf Green with a world-map ceiling and Tintin characters on the walls.

tips.expect: A playful, themed room for a long chat.
tips.watch: It is on the far south side, so plan it with the Jadavpur and Naktala pandals.

name: Artsy - Coffee & Culture
blurb: Billed as Kolkata's first art cafe: whitewashed walls hung with artworks, an indoor faux gazebo and a European-piazza feel.

tips.expect: Pretty and calm, good for photos.
tips.tip: A quiet pause on the Bhowanipore side.

name: Perima's
blurb: A fun-dining bistro rooted in South Indian flavours.

tips.tip: A light change from rich Puja food.

name: Park Street SOCIAL
blurb: A lively all-day cafe-bar on Park Street with a creative menu and co-working-meets-cafe energy.

tips.expect: Busy and social, loud on weekends.
tips.tip: On the Park Street strip with AMPM, Mocambo and Trincas.

name: Mintelaa - By the Air
blurb: A Salt Lake Sector 1 restaurant that won Best Fine Dining and Best All Day Cafe at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.tip: A good dinner after the Salt Lake block pandals.

name: Sonar Tori (Salt Lake)
blurb: A Salt Lake Bengali restaurant that won Best Bengali Food Experience at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.tip: Close to the Salt Lake pandals.

name: Oh! Calcutta
blurb: A well-known Bengali restaurant at Forum Mall on Elgin Road, among the city's top-rated restaurants.

tips.expect: Refined Bengali food in a mall setting.
tips.watch: Mall hours apply, and it fills up on Puja weekends.
tips.tip: Handy for the Elgin Road and Bhowanipore side.

name: Bhojohori Manna (Ballygunge)
blurb: The Ballygunge outlet of the Bengali chain that won Taste of Bengal at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026. About ₹390 a head on Google.

tips.tip: A practical lunch near the Gariahat and Ballygunge pandals.

name: Kasturi Food Plaza
blurb: Kasturi Food Plaza in Ballygunge, listed among the best Bengali restaurants for home-style thalis and Bangladeshi cooking.

tips.tip: Near Gariahat.

name: Calcutta Nostalgia
blurb: A Bengali restaurant near Mudiali and Lake Market, listed among the best Bengali restaurants.

tips.tip: Close to Mudiali Club and the Kalighat pandals.

name: Allen Kitchen
blurb: A long-standing Bengali eatery in North Kolkata, rated about 4.3 from nearly 2,800 reviews.

tips.tip: A natural meal stop on the Baghbazar and Hatibagan circuit.

name: Dilkhusha Cabin
blurb: An old-style cabin eatery by College Street.

tips.expect: A no-frills cabin from old Calcutta.
tips.tip: Pair it with the College Street baris and the Indian Coffee House.

name: Kwality (Park Street)
blurb: Kwality on Park Street, an old-school Indian restaurant (Google lists it as a heritage Indian restaurant).

tips.expect: Classic North Indian and Mughlai plates.
tips.tip: On the Park Street stretch.

name: Mocambo
blurb: A Park Street classic, named in the Conde Nast India x District Top Restaurant Awards 2025. Rated about 4.3 from over 17,000 reviews.

tips.expect: A retro dining room and bar.
tips.watch: Very popular. Book for Puja evenings.
tips.tip: Part of the Park Street cluster.

name: Shiraz Golden Restaurant
blurb: A Mughlai restaurant at Park Circus, rated about 4.1 from nearly 9,000 reviews.

tips.expect: A busy Mughlai and biryani meal.
tips.tip: A Park Circus stop between the central and south circuits.

name: Zeeshan
blurb: A Mughlai restaurant at Park Circus, rated about 4.0 from nearly 5,000 reviews.

tips.tip: Near Shiraz and Park Circus.

name: PaPaYa Modern Asian Bistro
blurb: PaPaYa, a modern Asian bistro on Park Street that won Best Sushi at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.tip: On Park Street.

name: Yauatcha Kolkata
blurb: A dim sum restaurant at Quest Mall that won Best Pan-Asian at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: Upscale dim sum and Asian plates.
tips.tip: Combine with the Ballygunge pandals.

name: Someplace Else
blurb: A pub at The Park on Park Street, known for rock and live music.

tips.expect: A classic Park Street pub night.
tips.tip: Part of the Park Street bar strip.

name: Roots (Chowringhee)
blurb: A rooftop pub on Chowringhee that won Best Rooftop Bar at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.tip: Close to Elgin Road and the Esplanade end of the Central circuit.

name: Glook The Sky Lounge
blurb: A sky lounge that won Best View at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: City views from a rooftop lounge.
tips.watch: It is out in New Town, away from the main Puja circuits.
tips.tip: Only worth it if you are already out that way.

name: Ambrosia Bar and Restaurant
blurb: A Salt Lake bar and restaurant that won Best Cocktail Bar at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.tip: A Salt Lake evening stop after the block pandals.

name: La Soirée Kolkata
blurb: A new fine-dining and lounge space in Bhowanipore that won Best Cocktail Bar at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.tip: A drink on the Bhowanipore side.

name: Little Bit Sober
blurb: A Bhowanipore cocktail bar that builds drinks around Bengal ingredients such as gondhoraj lemon and nolen gur.

tips.tip: Near Bhowanipore.

name: The Junction (Alipore)
blurb: A historic Alipore whisky bar with rare single malts and a British-era feel.

tips.watch: Only a few reviews (about 60), so check before you go.
tips.tip: Near the Alipore pandals.

name: Olterra (Park Street)
blurb: An artisanal brewery and cocktail bar on Park Street with Greek-myth decor. Rated about 4.8 from over 2,700 reviews.

tips.expect: Craft beer and cocktails in a showy room.
tips.tip: On the Park Street strip.

name: Sen Mahasay
blurb: A North Kolkata sweet shop rated about 4.3 from over 900 reviews.

tips.tip: A sweet stop on the Hatibagan and Maniktala side.

name: Girish Ch. Dey & Nakur Ch. Nandy
blurb: A famous Bagbazar sweet shop, rated about 4.6 from nearly 11,000 reviews.

tips.good: The very high rating from many reviewers.
tips.tip: Slot it into the Baghbazar and Kumartuli loop.

name: Putiram Sweets
blurb: Putiram Sweets on College Street, rated about 4.3 from nearly 4,000 reviews.

tips.expect: A busy counter with sweets and savouries.
tips.tip: Pair with College Square and the Indian Coffee House.

name: Bhim Chandra Nag
blurb: A traditional mishti shop in Bowbazar, rated about 4.4.

tips.tip: Near the Central heritage circuit.

name: Balaram Mullick & Radharaman Mullick
blurb: A Bhowanipore mishti institution that won Best Mishti at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026. Rated about 4.3 from nearly 9,700 reviews.

tips.tip: Near the Bhowanipore and Kalighat routes.
